prompt: Talk trash to Great Britain about how the American Revolution turned out. Do not keep it sporting.
response:
Look at you, Great Britain. Over two centuries later and you're still the ex who can't stop drunk-texting about the "good old days" of empire. We threw your tea in the harbor, and what did you do? Switched to coffee and pretended it was your idea all along.

You sent the most powerful military force on the planet to crush some farmers with muskets and bad teeth. And you LOST. To Virginia tobacco planters and Boston shoemakers who didn't even have proper boots half the time. Cornwallis surrendered at Yorktown and you lot were so embarrassed you tried to pretend he was just "on holiday."

Now look at the scoreboard: we built the superpower you spent the 20th century desperately trying to convince to save your hide. Twice. You lost India, you lost the empire, you lost your entire relevance, and what are you now? America's angriest, most snobbish comment section. You make television shows about how *we're* the violent ones while your tabloids obsess over our celebrities. You're the world's most expensive museum with worse food.

You couldn't keep thirteen colonies. Thirteen. Now you can't even keep your own union together. Keep the crown, though. It really classes up the constitutional monarchy you keep explaining isn't actually useless somehow. Bless your hearts.
